description: Plans the film before the script. From the source, a preset and a length it declares an arc in named movements, a motif with its plant and payoff, a colour script, a musical arc, the hook strategy and the open loop the film will hold. Every later pass answers to the accepted spine.
researcher_question: What is the one arc this material can carry, and where does it turn?
